title: ResultSafe Core normative requirements
summary: Complete normative requirement baseline for identity, algebra, behavior, projections, implementation, testing, integrity, and release.

items.title: Canonical identity
items.statement: Every internal entity and canonical document MUST use a persisted canonical lowercase RFC 9562 UUIDv7 identity and an absolute reference.
verification: Validate UUID version and RFC variant

items.title: Language-neutral Result algebra
items.statement: The canonical Result MUST define language-neutral SUCCESS and FAILURE variants without prescribing language-specific field names or runtime classes.
verification: Validate all language mappings against both variants

items.title: Exclusive Result branch
items.statement: A valid Result MUST contain exactly one active branch and MUST expose only the payload associated with that active branch.

items.title: Wrapper immutability
items.statement: Result and Option wrapper state MUST be immutable at runtime while nested payload mutability remains explicitly outside the core guarantee.
verification: Confirm payload reference is not deep-frozen

items.title: Callback determinism
items.statement: Every operation accepting callbacks MUST define branch eligibility, invocation count, argument order, evaluation order, and exception propagation.

items.title: Explicit exception contract
items.statement: Extraction failures and callback exceptions MUST have explicit categories, stable mapping rules, and preservation of diagnostic cause where the target language supports it.

items.title: Sound type projection
items.statement: A language projection MUST NOT assert a type property or branch that its runtime checks cannot establish from available evidence.
verification: Compare runtime validation with declared output

items.title: Sound refinement
items.statement: Refinement MUST verify configured payload presence, field ownership, validator callability, strict fields, forbidden fields, and validator-derived output types.

items.title: Complete variant matching
items.statement: Variant matchers MUST preserve every registered handler, infer result types, and prevent strict execution until all statically known variants are handled.
verification: Execute first handler after a long chain
Execute last handler after a long chain
Reject premature strict run at compile time

items.title: Async semantic parity
items.statement: Async refinement MUST share validation semantics with synchronous refinement and MUST define ordering, rejection propagation, and cancellation limitations.

items.title: Projection separation
items.statement: Language, integration, relational, and database profile projections MUST remain derived and independently versioned from the canonical Contract IR.

items.title: Language-neutral relational projection
items.statement: The relational projection MUST define logical relations, keys, constraints, revisions, ownership, and rebuild semantics without depending on a programming language or database vendor.
verification: Verify no TypeScript or Python runtime dependency
Verify tenant key rules for operational overlays

items.title: Derived SQLite profile
items.statement: SQLite MUST be a reproducible read-model profile of the relational projection and MUST never allocate canonical identity or become Contract IR authority.

items.title: TypeScript projection
items.statement: The TypeScript runtime MUST project SUCCESS as exact `{ok:true,value}` and FAILURE as exact `{ok:false,error}` while satisfying every applicable canonical scenario.
verification: Test packed ESM and CJS artifacts

items.title: Python projection
items.statement: The `resultsafe` PyPI distribution and `resultsafe` import root MUST expose frozen slotted generic Ok, Err, and Some values, singleton NOTHING, ResultExtractionError with identity-preserving payload, and only canonical snake_case free operations without changing the 25 Python-applicable neutral contracts.

items.title: AASDVGS admission boundary
items.statement: AASDVGS integration MUST be an independently governed admission projection and MUST NOT mint or infer AASDVGS package publication authority locally.
verification: Verify no reused external package IDs
Verify external authority remains unresolved until approved

items.title: Complete traceability
items.statement: Every implementation change MUST trace from source evidence through finding, decision, requirement, contract, scenario, projection, and verification evidence.

items.title: Package integrity
items.statement: Every staged and released corpus MUST have canonicalized file digests, a deterministic tree digest, exact inventory, and validation evidence.

items.title: Immutable contract release
items.statement: An approved contract release MUST resolve exact record revisions, carry a digest, remain immutable, and require a successor release for semantic changes.

items.title: Truthful test status
items.statement: Validation evidence MUST distinguish structural, behavioral, security, and long-running execution and MUST never report unexecuted scenarios as passing.
verification: Enforce explicit command for deferred test classes

items.title: Optional structured Failure
items.statement: ResultSafe MUST provide a portable structured Failure with required schema_version and qualified code without constraining Result<T,E> or coercing arbitrary E.
verification: Execute bounded constructor and compatibility scenarios

items.title: Optional binary Cause model
items.statement: Cause MUST remain an optional six-variant binary semantic model that preserves arbitrary E identity, exact grouping and order, and bounded acyclic validation.

items.title: Optional Exit model
items.statement: Exit MUST contain exactly Success or Failure, preserve arbitrary T or complete Cause E identity, and accept Failure with Empty Cause.
verification: Execute Empty failure and conversion scenarios

items.title: Cause and Exit semantic projections
items.statement: Language projections MUST bind every Cause and Exit semantic variant without changing Result operation bindings or claiming unsupported cross-language implementation.
verification: Require implemented TypeScript and Python cells after executable APIs qualify
Preserve 23 Result operations and 88 Result cells

items.title: Core public modularity
items.statement: The TypeScript core package MUST have zero runtime dependencies, expose every intended public module from both root and a direct subpath, perform no import-time side effects, require no codecs, adapters, storage, or runtime registry, and keep optional integrations in separate packages.
verification: Validate the public module registry against source exports
Verify all derived export conditions in the exact packed manifest
Run isolated ESM, CJS, and declaration consumers
Prove zero runtime dependencies and no import side effects

items.title: Explicit codec package boundary
items.statement: Cause and Exit JSON codecs MUST be explicit operations in @resultsafe/core-fp-codec-json, use governed valid and malformed vectors, and create zero dependency from @resultsafe/core-fp-result.
verification: Validate exact package and peer dependency policy
Execute all valid and malformed codec vectors
Prove core has no codec dependency
Bind exact packed artifacts in final qualification

items.title: Separate Effect adapter boundary
items.statement: Effect Cause and Exit interoperability MUST reside in @resultsafe/adapter-core-fp-effect, support Effect 3.22.1 as an exact required peer, report semantic loss explicitly, and create zero dependency from core.
verification: Validate exact package path and peer dependency policy
Execute Cause and Exit adapter tests against Effect 3.22.1
Prove no Effect dependency enters core
Bind QUALIFIED_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT to the PASS_LOCAL_ATOMIC effect-adapter child without claiming release approval
